The Perceptual Quality Auditor noted slight blur, which aligns with the 'plastic' texture of the concrete. The severity of the floating object is high because it disrupts the scene's physical logic, even if the bannister itself is mostly coherent.

The core components (handrail, balusters, incline) are present and geometrically consistent. However, the alignment score is penalized because the 'Newel post' requirement is technically failed (the rail floats at the top), and the presence of the unrelated, hallucinated sculpture distracts from the primary class definition. It is a 'bannister' but an incomplete/structurally flawed one.
